ValidationRule.description: Systemic issue description and category are mandatory when a complaint is possible systemic issue
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), ISPICKVAL(IDR_Is_Common__c,'Yes'), ISBLANK(IDR_Systemic_Issue_Description__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select 'Why is this a possible systemic issue' if YES to 'Are any of the issues possibly systemic?'
